journey.name: pubky ring choice rows
journey.description:
Verifies that the Pubky Ring choice screen lists every Ring identity straight away under its truncated key and fills each name in as its profile lookup finishes. It also verifies that tapping a row shows a spinner on that row only and disables every row until adoption finishes.
Precondition, outside the Capabilities table in journeys/README.md: Pubky Ring installed on the same simulator or device and signed by the same Apple team, so it shares Bitkit's pubky.shared keychain group. It holds at least two identities, at least one with a profile name published where this Bitkit build resolves profiles. Without Pubky Ring, run these steps as a manual test and name the missing capability in the PR. Bitkit is an onboarded E2E build with Paykit UI enabled and no Pubky identity. Use the test simulator UDID for <UDID>. <ring-pubky> is a Ring identity's bare z32 key without the "pubky" prefix, and <named-ring-pubky> is the one with a published name. Tapping that row signs in with it.
iOS-only, with no Android counterpart. Android shows one loading line in place of the rows while it loads and while it adopts, and tags every row "PubkyChoiceIdentity". iOS keeps the rows up and tags each one "PubkyChoiceRing_<pubky>". See README.md.

actions.action: Run `xcrun simctl terminate <UDID> to.bitkit`, then `xcrun simctl launch <UDID> to.bitkit`, so no Ring row profile is remembered from earlier in the session
If the PIN screen appears, unlock the wallet
Tap the header profile button (id "ProfileButton"). If nothing happens, Pubky is still initializing: wait a moment and tap it again
If the Profile intro (id "ProfileIntro") appears, tap Continue (id "ProfileIntro-button")
Verify the choice screen shows one row per Ring identity (id "PubkyChoiceRing_<ring-pubky>") and no create option (id "PubkyChoiceCreate")

Verify every row is already tappable and captioned with its truncated key in capitals: the key's first four and last four characters around "...". A row whose name has not arrived also shows that truncated key as its title. If every name is already showing, the lookups finished first: report "already resolved" rather than failing
Wait for the row for the named identity (id "PubkyChoiceRing_<named-ring-pubky>") to show its published name as its title
Verify that row keeps its truncated key as its caption, and any row whose identity has no published name still shows its truncated key as its title
Tap the row for the named identity (id "PubkyChoiceRing_<named-ring-pubky>")
Straight away, capture a snapshot and a screenshot before adoption finishes

Verify from the snapshot that every Ring row is disabled while the identity is adopted. A disabled button drops out of the snapshot's Targets list, so the signal is the "PubkyChoiceRing_" rows missing from Targets while the choice screen is still showing. If adoption finished before the capture, report "already adopted" rather than failing

Verify from the screenshot that only the tapped row shows a spinner in place of its key icon, while every other row keeps its key icon and its name or truncated key. The spinner has no identifier, so a snapshot cannot settle this. If adoption finished before the capture, report "already adopted" rather than failing
Verify the choice screen gives way to the contact import overview (id "ContactImportOverviewProfile") or Pay Contacts (id "PayContactsContinue")
